svg.title: zoom-wedge-dashed
svg.desc: zoom-in wedge: two thin dashed leaders (no heads) from the corners of a small unit to the corners of its expanded structure beside it; a short wedge label sits between the leaders; both ends share one horizontal midline | original (drawn for figgenie-paper-diagram, 2026-09-10) | units: pt at print size | keep the dash (1.5/1.5, 0.5 pt) distinct from control-arrow dashes
